probes.name: len253
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object
On Error GoTo Failed
Set f=Range("K3:K8").FormatConditions.Add(Type:=9,String:=String(253,"a"),TextOperator:=0)
Probe=S(f)
Exit Function
Failed:
Probe="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function Units(v As String) As String
Dim i As Long
Units=CStr(Len(v))
For i=1 To Len(v)
If i<=12 Or i>Len(v)-3 Then Units=Units & "," & CStr(AscW(Mid(v,i,1)))
Next
End Function
Function S(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
S="type=" & f.Type & ";op="
On Error Resume Next
Err.Clear
S=S & CStr(f.TextOperator) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";text=" & Units(f.Text) & ":err" & Err.Number
Err.Clear
S=S & ";formula=" & Units(f.Formula1) & ":err" & Err.Number
S=S & ";priority=" & f.Priority & ";stop=" & f.StopIfTrue
Exit Function
Failed:
S="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function

probes.name: search-offsets
probes.source:
Function Probe() As String
Dim u As String,x As Variant
u=ChrW(&HD83D) & ChrW(&HDE00)
Range("A1").Value=u & "x"
Probe="x=" & CStr(Application.Evaluate("SEARCH(""x"",A1)"))
Probe=Probe & "|q1s2=" & CStr(Application.Evaluate("SEARCH(""?"",A1,2)"))
Probe=Probe & "|q2s2=" & CStr(Application.Evaluate("SEARCH(""??"",A1,2)"))
Range("A1").Value="a" & u & "x"
Probe=Probe & "|q2s2b=" & CStr(Application.Evaluate("SEARCH(""??"",A1,2)"))
End Function
